source_hierarchy: issuer_primary > regulator_filings > transaction_confirmations > reputable_reporting > commentary; independent confirmation required for anonymously sourced projections

items.metric_or_event: Reuters says confidential filing submitted; no public terms or filed range yet
items.unknown_or_falsifier: Confidential filing is not public S-1 with audited financials accessible to user; 2027 timing not confirmed.

items.metric_or_event: Altman reportedly ruled out IPO in 2026 citing safety considerations
items.unknown_or_falsifier: Does not guarantee any 2027 listing or pricing.

items.metric_or_event: FT reported $278B projected cumulative negative FCF during 2026-2030 in investor/compute presentation
items.unknown_or_falsifier: Reported forecast, NOT realized cash spent or debt; company finance executive reportedly challenged accuracy; obtain original model, timeline and net vs gross spend.

items.metric_or_event: The Information reports an OpenAI product-finance employee publicly disputed reported $278B figure
items.unknown_or_falsifier: A social post described secondhand is not independently authenticated; store dispute, do not replace projection with certainty.

items.metric_or_event: September 2026 company annualized revenue ~USD 50B/year based on month, not audited full-year
items.unknown_or_falsifier: A single-month run-rate, channel scope and collection not independently audited.

items.metric_or_event: OpenAI reportedly targets at least USD 70B/year annualized exit rate by December 2026
items.unknown_or_falsifier: $70B is forecast, not September recognized revenue or audited FY2026 revenue.

items.metric_or_event: OpenAI revenue excludes selected cloud partner sales while Anthropic counts gross partner sales; September $70B OpenAI reported proxy previously blended bases
items.unknown_or_falsifier: Require GAAP principal-agent bridge, equivalent channel and revenue vs bookings normalization before multiples.

items.metric_or_event: OpenAI said enterprise exceeds 40% of its revenues and expects consumer parity by end 2026
items.unknown_or_falsifier: Issuer-defined segment categories, not audited; no guarantee year-end parity.

items.metric_or_event: OpenAI said strategic Nvidia inference capacity 3 GW plus 2 GW training on Vera Rubin systems
items.unknown_or_falsifier: Do not sum as realized load or add to Broadcom 10 GW without de-duplication of physical sites and supplier contract stages.

items.metric_or_event: OpenAI and Atlassian announced expansion of agents/model distribution in Rovo
items.unknown_or_falsifier: No published contract value, guaranteed inference demand or profit margin; do not infer monetized revenue.

items.metric_or_event: Issuer disclosed $122B financing with $852B post-money value; no evidence all commitments settled same day
items.unknown_or_falsifier: Do not add to $730B pre-money as separate valuation or equate commitments to unrestricted cash.

items.metric_or_event: Reuters reports SoftBank $11B bond financing at coupon/yield up to 9.75% amid concentrated OpenAI exposure
items.unknown_or_falsifier: This is cost of SoftBank debt, not automatically OpenAI's WACC; issuer source and CUSIPs needed for exact pricing.

items.metric_or_event: Reuters reports CoreWeave provider refinancing stress and concentrations in AI computing contracts
items.unknown_or_falsifier: CRWV distress does not establish lost OpenAI demand, OpenAI default risk or net economic loss.

items.metric_or_event: WSJ says OpenAI computing chief Sachin Katti leaving in November after a year
items.unknown_or_falsifier: Personnel change is neither an automatic capacity failure nor zero-risk event; monitor successor/deployments.

items.metric_or_event: Reuters says OpenAI/Anthropic discussing publication scope of independent model safety evaluations
items.unknown_or_falsifier: Cannot convert into binary governance quality or IPO timing probability without disclosed regulatory/issuer consequence.

critical_contradictions.rule: Date and gross/net basis differences; do not treat forecast $70B as actual September ARR
Attribution contested; provisional projection only until audited/presented directly

date_rule: Published source date not intraday timestamp; no assumed midnight availability
